tractability.caveat: PREDICTED-TIER, RULE 4e. HAX1 has no experimental structure (0 PDB entries) and no usable homolog (no Pfam family; the only query available is the model itself). It was folded with ESMFold at pTM 0.215 (fold_confidence 'unreliable', <0.55) and is 98.2% predicted-disordered (metapredict). The pocket scan ran on the model and returned pockets, but NO site basis survives (no holo donor, no caller site_residues, no homolog), so site_hypothesis_basis is not_established and the computed axis carries NO site definition (rule 4e/4.0). The pooled cavity volume (1024-1369 A^3) exceeds the 1000 A^3 merge threshold (rule 4a) and the high druggability values are max_druggability_no_ligand_site artifacts on an unreliable fold. Read: 'we could not crystallise it and the model is unsure' — the honest finding for a structure-less, disordered orphan, returned WITH warnings rather than nulled.

findings: Both actives come from HAX1 target-engagement chemoproteomics (Kinobead and cellular pull-down assays); the best measured binding is ~340 uM (molregno 2955915). No potent, characterised small-molecule series exists.
340 uM is not a therapeutically reachable potency; there is no concentration-independent potency to defend.
No experimental structure exists (0 PDB entries), so 'one crystal form' and 'crystallisation-additive' checks are not applicable — the only geometry is an unreliable ESMFold model (pTM 0.215).
PAINS/aggregator screening not performed: there is no potent active for which such a flag would change the (already insufficient) conclusion.
No terminated clinical programs found against HAX1 (drugs_by_accession=0).
